$comment: The one list of GitHub repositories the e2e suites read, each at the exact commit it is read at.
scripts/fetch-github-pins.mjs (Playwright globalSetup) makes a shallow checkout of each commit under tmp/github-checkouts/<owner>/<repo>/<sha>;
the e2e guard (helpers/demodb-guard.ts + helpers/fake-github.ts) answers api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net
from those checkouts. A branch name (`refs`) is answered only by the pin that maps it; anything else fails the test loudly.
One repository may have several pins: the lane picks which one answers its refs with DATATUG_E2E_GITHUB_PINS=<id>[,<id>] (default: the first pin of the repository).
Bump a pin deliberately, with the specs that depend on it. helpers/github-pins.unit.ts checks the workflows and the product code agree with this file.
